more.def: Easy to harm or attack because of being weak, small or not well protected.
examples: Young turtles are vulnerable to hungry birds on the beach.
A castle on a flat plain was vulnerable to attack.
She felt vulnerable on the dark street without a flashlight.

easy.def: A big bird that eats animals that have died.
examples: A vulture flew in the sky.

more.def: A large bird with a bald head that eats the bodies of animals that are already dead.
examples: A vulture circled high above the desert.
Vultures help clean up the land by eating dead animals.
The vulture's bald head and broad wings are easy to spot.
